mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.09% is historically low, compressing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% and federal funds rate remains below 0.1%, it signals a recessionary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% AND FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a late-cycle expansion with high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals strong demand for housing and consumer goods, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.0 (index, 2017=100), it signals strong supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of retail sales (RSAFS) at 437,648 million dollars is high, signaling strong consumer demand and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when RSAFS > 400,000.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 400,000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when RSAFS > 400,000 AND HOUST > 1000.
